scenes.text: Claude built an invoice reminder tool with one hard rule. Never chase what shouldn't be chased. Paid, disputed and paused accounts are skipped, and so is a customer who promised to pay.

The test build found eighty-three gaps. Customers created by an import had no account owner, so the promise-broken email had nobody to go to. And with sending off, nothing said if a held final notice counted as sent. All eighty-three are fixed.
Chaser starts at two hundred and thirty-three dollars a month, billed yearly, for up to four users. If you chase late invoices from a spreadsheet, build your own.
